title: SPROUT Sync Schema (v1)
description: Per-student sync blob for the public SPROUT beta. One file per student per export: Sprout_<student>_<date>.json. Local-first — this file is the ONLY thing that ever moves between devices; no server collection ever. PII law: first names only, no emails, no device identifiers beyond a renameable random device tag.

_sync.description: Envelope: schema marker, version, student, device tag, export stamps.

device.description: Random per-device tag. User-renameable. Never a fingerprint.

progress.description: Lesson-key -> true map, exactly the engine's own shape ('<learner>_w<N>_d<day>_b<n>' or curriculum lesson id). No timestamps here: completion times are NOT tracked by the engine, so LWW at merge = a done key wins over an absent one, and un-done keys from a NEWER export clear the key.

quiz.description: quizId -> {attempts, best, total, at}. Merge: best wins on max(best), last = newest 'at'.

tests.description: Same shape as quiz, keyed by '<learner>_w<N>_test'.

hours.description: student -> date -> {planned, practiced}. Merge: max per field per day (additive data can double-count across devices; taking max keeps 'hours today' honest without losing the bigger true total).

practice.description: student -> date -> subject -> {minutes, items, correct, streak_best}. Merge: max per metric per (date, subject).

streams.description: student -> '<date>|<genId>' -> {level, cursor, attempts, correct, streak, best, at}. Merge: newest 'at' wins; streak/best take max.

notes.description: OPTIONAL (parent toggle). student -> lessonId -> {text, updated_at, highlights}. Included only when the exporter checks 'include my notes'.

merge_policy.progress: LWW per lesson-key by export freshness: keys present (true) in the newest export win; a newer export's ABSENT key clears it (an un-toggled block un-dones). Never silently lost: the pre-merge state of every changed key is recorded in the parent's conflict log when devices disagree.
merge_policy.quiz_tests: best + last both kept: best = max(best), last = the record with the newest 'at'. Conflict flagged when best-source and last-source come from different devices.
merge_policy.dedupe: Exact duplicate (student, lesson-key, same outcome) events collapse; device tags are recorded so the parent sees how many devices contributed.
merge_policy.hours_practice: max per metric per day/subject — additive sums would double-count when both devices log the same class session via a shared file.

pii_law: First names only (user ids are already first names).
No emails anywhere in the blob.
Device identity = random tag 'd_' + 16 chars, renameable by the user in the parent dashboard.
Everything stays in the parent device's localStorage under 'sprout_demo_v1.dash_v1' — wiped by the demo's own 'Clear this demo' button.
